REJECT
The extracted pieces (the shard-matrix, pass-with-no-tests and uncommitted-only loops, plus the three report loops) account for only about 25–30 of the 77 complexity points, so the untouched nested logic between them (roughly lines 312–400, which builds `gatingRuns`, `dropped`, `outside` and `configDropped`) almost certainly leaves `Js` well above 15. The source file wasn't available here, so this is an estimate from the diff rather than a measured score.
